purpose: Teach: 柏崎/佐野/矢野/松永/白石/吉岡/小松/亀井

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、新潟県柏崎の原発研究の論文を読め
lines.en: Ren, read the paper on nuclear power research from Kashiwazaki, Niigata.
lines.style: Clipped, direct instruction. Flat authority—no warmth, no punishment. The tone of someone who expects competence and doesn't feel the need to convince.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導教授の佐野先生のご研究を継承します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll carry forward Professor Sano's research.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness. Quick acceptance without hesitation. A respectful nod in the voice—not obsequious, but genuine commitment to the task ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の矢野先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren, contact Professor Yano about the collaborative research.
lines.style: Same clipped cadence as before. A task assigned, not debated. Slight pause after the name—letting it land as the next concrete step.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で松永助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll attend the conference and listen to Assistant Professor Matsunaga's presentation.
lines.style: Slightly lifted energy—he's already thinking ahead to the conference. Still formal, but there's a note of active purpose underneath the deference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の白石先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren, reference Professor Shiraishi's paper in the literature as well.
lines.style: The same measured instruction—adding to the list, not reconsidering it. No inflection of doubt. Hiroshi expects this will be done.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の吉岡先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll seek guidance from Yoshioka, a senior member in the lab.
lines.style: Polite acceptance again. A slight slowing on 「仰ぎます」—he's acknowledging the humility of asking for help, which is the right tone for this formal context.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の小松教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren, coordinate a meeting with Professor Komatsumoto from the international partnership.
lines.style: Returning to the directive voice. Clear, unbending. This is the kind of task that requires initiative—Hiroshi trusts Ren will handle it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、亀井事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll submit the application to Kamei, the administrative officer, for research funding.
lines.style: The final confirmation. A touch more weight on this one—it's the practical closing step. Still respectful, but with a sense of having absorbed the whole chain of action.
